history_head_description: Voice of God Tabernacle was founded in 1995 by Pastor Jean-Claude Dupuy, shortly after he relocated to Ottawa, Ontario. Its story began with modest meetings in the basement of his home alongside his family and a few believers in the Message of the Hour.
